title: As the US midterms approach, AI is going to emerge as a key issue concerning voters | Nathan E Sanders and Bruce Schneier | The Guardian
summary: The Trump administration's executive order restricts state regulation of AI, favoring industry interests and setting up a new ideological battleground for the midterm elections. Despite public favor for AI regulation, this move aligns with big tech and challenges populist consumer protections.
sentiment_reason: The executive order is seen as a negative action for the market as it undermines consumer protections and aligns with big tech interests, potentially leading to a negative sentiment among those concerned about AI's impact on society.
